articles.title: The Vocabulary of Vulnerability: 10 Wonderfully Untranslatable Words from Around the World for Complex and Difficult Emotions
articles.highlight: 语言是我们举到唇边品尝自身经验的圣杯——一个通过赋予内容以形状而约束其所容之物的容器。
articles.summary: 文章探讨语言如何塑造情感体验，并介绍来自不同文化的10个无法直译却精准捕捉复杂情绪的词语。它揭示了每种语言如何编码文化对“可被感受”的边界，值得一读以拓展情感词汇与跨文化理解。

articles.sourceExcerpt: Language is the chalice we lift to our lips to taste our own experience — a vessel that constrains what it contains by giving it its own shape. The more complex our experience, the more muddled the emotions that comprise it, the more it spills outside what language can hold. And yet we live in language — narrative is the neurocognitive pillar of personhood and emotions are how the brain interprets bodily sensations, an interpretation achieved largely by naming.

zh.title: unlazy：让AI智能体摆脱懒惰的深度树方法
zh.highlight: 深度树方法将任务拆到N层，给每个叶子节点整个任务的全部时间预算，从而让努力随深度成倍增加。
zh.summary: 该仓库提出针对AI模型懒惰问题的Depth Tree方法：把任务递归拆分为N层，每个叶子节点都获得与原始任务相同的完整时间预算，使推理努力随深度指数级增长。它基于2025-2026年关于模型欠思考与过早完成的研究，为提升智能体在复杂任务上的表现提供了新思路。
zh.failureAnalysis: 这种方法可能因计算成本急剧上升而难以落地，尤其在商业API调用中每个叶子都获得完整预算意味着开销爆炸。其效果依赖任务可拆解性，且缺乏真实场景的基准验证；若模型本身能力不足，单纯增加深度只会放大错误。

en.highlight: The Depth Tree method splits a task N layers deep and gives every leaf the full time budget of the whole task, so effort multiplies with depth.
en.summary: This repository presents the Depth Tree method, which recursively splits a task into N layers and grants each leaf node the full time budget of the original task, making reasoning effort grow exponentially with depth. Grounded in 2025-2026 research on model underthinking and premature completion, it offers a novel way to improve agent performance on complex tasks.
en.failureAnalysis: The method may inflate compute costs dramatically, as every leaf consumes the whole task budget, which is impractical for commercial APIs. Its effectiveness depends on task decomposability and lacks real-world validation; simply increasing depth may amplify errors.
en.title: unlazy: Depth Tree Method to Counter AI Agent Laziness
